title: Grid backtracking: word search
summary: Trace a word through orthogonally adjacent cells of a rectangular board. Track the cells used by the current path so each may be used once.
code: if not board or not board[0]:

triggers: spell a word along neighboring cells
a grid cell can be reused in another branch
prompts: Can a sequence of letters be traced on adjacent tiles without touching any tile twice?
Check whether a robot can follow a given sequence of labels on an orthogonal grid without revisiting a position.
invariant: The used set contains exactly the earlier cells of the active candidate path.
mantra: Mark on entry and unmark when the branch ends.
pitfalls: A global visited set blocks valid paths that reach a cell by a different route.

anchors.name: Word Search
anchors.trick: Track visited positions for each candidate path.

complexity.time: O(R × C × 4^L) upper bound for word length L

mutations.explanation: Retains cells from failed attempts and can block the only successful path.
